issueId.description: The issue to associate the attachment with. Can be a UUID or issue identifier (e.g., LIN-123). Example: "590a1127-f98b-49fc-ba74-2df8751c089e"

url.description: Attachment location which is also used as a unique identifier for the attachment. Example: "https://example.com/123"

iconUrl.description: An icon url to display with the attachment. Should be of jpg or png format. Example: "https://example.com/icon.png"

metadata.description: Attachment metadata object with string and number values. Example: {"exceptionId": "exc-123"}

groupBySource.description: Indicates if attachments for the same source application should be grouped in the Linear UI.

createAsUser.description: Create attachment as a user with the provided name. This option is only available to OAuth applications creating attachments in actor=application mode.

commentBody.description: Create a linked comment with markdown body.

startsAt.description: The start date of the cycle in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z"

endsAt.description: The end date of the cycle in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-01-29T00:00:00Z"

completedAt.description: The completion date of the cycle in ISO 8601 format.
